title: APS RPAC Meeting 2/13/2026 - Resource Adequacy Update, Resource Costs follow-up (E3), 2026 IRP Timeline
summary: Describes the 2025-2026 APS Resource Adequacy study underpinning the 2026 IRP: 44 weather years with hourly chronology, stochastic forced outages, chronological tracking of batteries and fuel-limited gas, explicit daily gas pipeline limits, 0.1 LOLE target. APS moves to Perfect Capacity (PCAP) accreditation starting 2026; ELCC surfaces capture solar-storage interactions. Pipeline-limited fuel supply shifts reliability risk outside the summer peak. E3 reviewed APS capital cost assumptions. Few hard MW numbers.

findings.statement: 2025-2026 RA study: 44 weather years, stochastic outages, daily gas pipeline limits and interruptible transport rules, 0.1 LOLE target; current study year 2030; APS moves to PCAP-based planning reserve margin and ELCC accreditation starting with the 2026 IRP.

Under pipeline-limited fuel availability, expected unserved energy and LOLE spread beyond summer into other months and hours; gas fuel transport rights 'designed for yesterday's peak conditions' flagged as a reliability risk.

open_questions: What PRM % and ELCC values resulted from the 2025 RA study?
